about: Pages whose address changed, each new address with the one it replaced (2026-10-23: every page's address took the name its menu entry has). next.config.js redirects each old address to the new one, permanently: they are bookmarked and linked from outside. lib/content/server.ts reads a renamed page's old address from a live release that does not publish the new one yet, which is the case right after the deploy that renames it: the release gate holds the next release until production runs the new code. That half can go once the live release carries the new names; the redirects stay.
